messages:
niko: Quick check — rolling model v2.4 tonight 23:00-03:00 UTC. Need 8 L40s in uk-west for canary + quick rollback window. PR #4287 (terraform) is ready, just need capacity confirmation.
aaron: I can run a quick quota scan. Standby — pulling current free slots.
aaron: Current pool shows 4 free L40s in uk-west, 2 pending from vendor but not reserved. We can probably scavenge 2 more from demo, but won't reach 8.
vendor-ops: Vendor update: we have 6 L40s available for immediate reservation in UK-W. They require a 24h PO or a short-term contract for the night. Lead time ~2h after PO.
lisa: Finance — are we ok to approve a one-night PO fallback? If so, what's the estimated spend? Need ballpark to sign off.
iko: Estimated spike ~£1.2k for the night if we reserve 8 L40s + burst. If demo borrow covers 2, net extra ~£800. @lisa does that work?
lisa: If it's under £1k we can fast-track via emergency spend. Please add a note in the PO referencing ticket INF-512.
oncall: Alternative plan: we can fallback to eu-west1 h100s (10 GPUs) with slightly higher latency (≈12–18ms extra) but lower immediate billing friction — no PO. Risk: cross-region egress for some traffic.
samir: Spot fallback is also an option but preemptions likely during the window. For canary I'd avoid spot unless we have auto-retry and checkpointing in place.
iko: PR snippet — if someone from infra can lgtm and apply the tf changes that pin the hostAffinity and reservation block, we can try reserve-first then deploy. Terraform snippet:
```
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "canary_night" {
  region = "uk-west"
  sku    = "l40"
  count  = 8
  lease  = "2025-03-12T23:00:00Z/2025-03-13T03:00:00Z"
}
```
aron: (typo) — i meant: I can open a quick demo-pool borrow request for 2 L40s, tagging INF-512.
vendor-ops: If finance approves the one-night PO we can confirm 6 instantly and hold them for 3 hours while terraform runs.
oncall: Recommendation: try demo borrow (2) + vendor PO for 6, fallback to eu-west1 h100s if any step fails. That keeps canary stable.
iko: Sounds good. @samir can you add the auto-retry checkpoints to the canary job? If preempted we should stop rollout.
samir: Will add a small checkpoint every 1000 steps and a retry backoff. PR coming in 15m.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: terraform plan for PR #4287 finished — no drift. Ready to apply after capacity reservation confirmed. :white_check_mark:
lisa: Approved emergency PO up to £1k. Please include finance reference INF-512 and send invoice to procurement@redwood.com.
vendor-ops: PO received, reserving 6 L40s for 2h hold. ETA: they will show as reserved in the console in ~6 minutes.
iko: Thanks all — I'll wait for reserved confirmation then ping to apply. If vendor slots don't appear by 22:40 UTC we switch to eu-west1 h100s.
vendor-ops: Reserved flags set. You should see reservations in the vendor console now. :thumbsup:
niko: I see them. Applying terraform now.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: terraform apply started for PR #4287 by niko.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: terraform apply complete — resources provisioned.
iko: Canary rollout started. Monitoring logs and metrics.
oncall: Oncall monitoring listening. Ping here if latency or error rate >1%.
samir: Checkpointing enabled, will post PR link when ready.
aaron: Demo borrow returned — we ended up not needing the 2 from demo. Closing that request.
iko: Night rollout stable (23:35 UTC). Will post final postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
